h1: Custom 12 oz Barware for Branded Events
metaDescription: Shop custom 12 oz barware at Perfect Imprints. Perfect for branded events and corporate gifts. Order bulk today!
introHtml: Custom 12 oz barware hits the sweet spot between a standard rocks glass and a highball, making it ideal for serving cocktails, beer, or soft drinks at corporate events and trade shows. This versatile size works well with screen printing or etching, allowing your logo to stand out on glass or stainless steel. Whether you're outfitting a company happy hour or creating a takeaway gift for a golf tournament, 12 oz barware offers a substantial feel without being oversized.
heroAltText: Custom 12 oz barware featuring a company logo etched on a glass tumbler, perfect for corporate events.
